en.headline: FEHD foreman charged with misconduct over bogus littering tickets
en.dek: The ICAC charged a 41-year-old Food and Environmental Hygiene Department officer with misconduct in public office after he allegedly issued five false fixed-penalty notices that led to court warrants and one wrongful…

zh.headline: 食環署管工涉發虛假垃圾票 被廉政公署控公職人員行為失當
zh.dek: 一名41歲食環署管工被控向五人發出虛假定額罰款通知書，導致法庭發出拘捕令及一人被錯誤拘捕，案件由廉政公署跟進。

en.headline: Retail sales rise 4.6% in June for 14th consecutive month
en.dek: The value of total retail sales reached HK$31.5 billion in June, with online sales up 11.6% and jewellery and watches jumping more than 20%, the Census and Statistics Department said.

zh.headline: 6月零售銷售額按年升4.6% 連續14個月增長
zh.dek: 政府統計處公布，6月零售業總銷貨價值暫定為315億元，按年升4.6%，網上銷售升11.6%，珠寶首飾、鐘錶及名貴禮物銷售升逾兩成。

en.headline: Huanggang Port to hold four days of drills with 36,000 civil-servant trips
en.dek: The government will mobilise about 36,000 civil-servant attendances across four dates this month to test clearance systems and capacity at the redeveloped checkpoint, with the largest exercise on 29 August.

zh.headline: 新皇崗口岸將演練四日 動員公務員約3.6萬人次
zh.dek: 政府本月四個日子啟動全政府總動員，徵召約3.6萬人次公務員模擬過境，測試皇崗口岸通關系統及運載能力，其中8月29日規模最大。

en.headline: HSBC first-half profit before tax rises 23% to US$19.5 billion
en.dek: The bank reported higher banking net interest income and strong wealth fee growth, declared a second interim dividend of US$0.10 per share and plans a share buy-back of up to US$1 billion.

zh.headline: 滙控上半年稅前盈利升23%至195億美元
zh.dek: 銀行業務淨利息收益及財富管理費用收入增長帶動業績，派第二次中期股息每股10美仙，並計劃最多10億美元股份回購。

en.headline: Yellow Working Heat Stress Warning issued at midday
en.dek: The Labour Department activated the Yellow Working Heat Stress Warning at 12.10pm as heat stress levels rose in parts of the territory under hot and humid conditions.

zh.headline: 黃色工作暑熱警告中午生效
zh.dek: 勞工處下午12時10分發出黃色工作暑熱警告，表示部分工作環境的熱壓力頗高。

en.headline: Coleman Wong climbs to career-high ATP ranking of 92
en.dek: The Hong Kong player rose 16 places after earning 92 ranking points from his run to the Los Cabos semi-finals, becoming the first local man inside the top 100.

zh.headline: 黃澤林ATP排名升至第92位創生涯新高
zh.dek: 港將上週洛斯卡沃斯四強之旅為他帶來92分，最新正式排名攀升16位至92，成為首位躋身男單前100的香港球員。

en.headline: Tuen Mun water supply restored after emergency pipe repair
en.dek: The Water Supplies Department completed urgent works on a 600mm main near Tuen Lee Street, restoring service to Villa Tiara, Hin Fat Estate and nearby estates from 9.30am.

zh.headline: 屯門水管搶修完成 怡峰園等屋苑供水恢復
zh.dek: 水務署完成青山公路近屯利街600毫米食水鋼管緊急維修，怡峰園、顯發邨、恆順園及冠峰園今早9時半起陸續恢復供水。

en.headline: Triad leader charged with murder over Tsim Sha Tsui bar attack
en.dek: A 40-year-old man known as Left Mouth faces a murder charge and a 52-year-old faces a charge of assisting an offender after the fatal assault on a 32-year-old businessman last month.

zh.headline: 尖沙咀酒吧謀殺案 三合會頭目左咀被控謀殺
zh.dek: 一名40歲外號「左咀」的三合會頭目被控謀殺，另一名52歲男子被控協助罪犯，案件與上月尖沙咀酒吧致命襲擊有關。

en.headline: Former prison officer jailed three years for assaulting inmate
en.dek: Tam Lik-chung was sentenced at the District Court after admitting he ordered and took part in an attack on a prisoner at Pik Uk Correctional Institution in December 2023.

zh.headline: 前懲教助理員襲擊在囚人士判囚三年
zh.dek: 譚力中承認於2023年12月在壁屋懲教所下令及參與襲擊一名在囚人士，區域法院周一判處監禁三年。

en.headline: Police hunt three suspects after man stabbed in To Kwa Wan stairwell
en.dek: A 21-year-old man was attacked with a meat cleaver on San Lau Street on Monday evening and taken to hospital with a severe arm wound; the case is classified as wounding.

zh.headline: 土瓜灣樓梯間斬人案 警追三名疑兇
zh.dek: 一名21歲男子周一傍晚在新樓街樓梯間遭三名男子以肉刀襲擊，手臂重傷送院，案件列為傷人。

en.headline: Burmese python spotted near Jardine Noonday Gun in Causeway Bay
en.dek: A two-to-three-metre snake was filmed on Victoria Park Road on Sunday night; an expert linked the appearance to recent heavy rain flooding natural habitats.

zh.headline: 銅鑼灣近午炮台現緬甸蟒 專家指或與大雨有關
zh.dek: 周日晚有人在維園道近怡和午炮台拍攝到一條長約兩至三米的蟒蛇，專家指近日大雨可能迫使其離開自然生境。

en.headline: Customs seizes 62 live birds at Lok Ma Chau Spur Line
en.dek: A 22-year-old Mainland man was arrested after officers found 62 suspected illegally imported live birds valued at about HK$12,000 in his baggage.

zh.headline: 海關落馬洲支線檢62隻懷疑非法進口活鳥
zh.dek: 海關周一在落馬洲支線管制站截獲一名22歲內地男旅客，在其行李檢獲62隻估計市值約1.2萬元的活鳥，並將其拘捕。

en.headline: Customs seizes three live cats at Lok Ma Chau Spur Line
en.dek: A 56-year-old Mainland woman was arrested after three suspected illegally imported cats valued at about HK$30,000 were found in her rucksack at the control point.

zh.headline: 海關落馬洲支線檢三隻懷疑非法進口活貓
zh.dek: 海關周一在落馬洲支線管制站截獲一名56歲內地女旅客，在其背囊檢獲三隻估計市值約3萬元的活貓，並將其拘捕。

en.headline: Security guard given suspended sentence for blank-vote comments
en.dek: A 38-year-old man was sentenced to two months’ jail suspended for three years after pleading guilty to publicly inciting others to cast invalid votes during the 2025 Legislative Council election.

zh.headline: 保安員網上鼓吹投白票判囚兩月緩刑三年
zh.dek: 38歲男子承認在2025年立法會選舉期間公開煽惑他人投無效票，西九龍裁判法院周一判處監禁兩個月，緩刑三年。

en.headline: Missing Tseung Kwan O woman found alive on Kwun Tong hillside
en.dek: Police said 60-year-old Ngan Lai-ching, missing since 24 July, was located near On Luen Village with minor abrasions and airlifted to hospital in a conscious state.

zh.headline: 將軍澳失蹤11日女子在觀塘山邊尋回
zh.dek: 警方表示，60歲區麗貞自7月24日失蹤後，周一在觀塘安聯村附近山坡尋回，手腳擦傷，清醒送院，無可疑情況。

en.headline: Four jailed over plots to steal Chanel goods worth HK$8.7 million
en.dek: The High Court sentenced four former warehouse workers to terms of up to seven years for conspiring to steal obsolete Chanel handbags and wallets from a Tsing Yi facility.

zh.headline: 四名前倉務員串謀盜竊Chanel貨品判囚最長七年
zh.dek: 高等法院周一判處四名前倉庫工人最高七年監禁，罪名是串謀從青衣貨倉盜竊價值至少870萬元的Chanel過季手袋及銀包。

en.headline: Mother and relative arrested after children eat cannabis sweets
en.dek: A six-year-old boy and 12-year-old girl were taken to hospital after falling ill at their Wang Tau Hom Estate home; the mother was arrested for suspected child abuse.

zh.headline: 兩童誤食懷疑含大麻糖果不適 母親及親戚被捕
zh.dek: 一名六歲男童及12歲女童周一下午在橫頭磡邨家中不適送院，母親涉嫌虐待兒童被捕，另一名親戚涉嫌藏毒被捕。

en.headline: Seven-year-old boy in critical condition with severe influenza A
en.dek: The Centre for Health Protection is investigating a severe paediatric influenza A case involving a previously healthy boy who developed shock and encephalopathy.

zh.headline: 七歲男童感染甲型流感危殆 併發休克及腦病變
zh.dek: 衞生防護中心正調查一宗嚴重兒童甲型流感個案，一名過往健康良好的七歲男童出現休克及腦病變，情況危殆。

en.headline: Safety manager dies after falling 10 floors at Kowloon City site
en.dek: A 39-year-old construction safety manager fell about 10 storeys at a Sa Po Road worksite on Monday afternoon and was later certified dead in hospital.

zh.headline: 九龍城地盤安全主任墮下約十層樓不治
zh.dek: 一名39歲地盤安全主任周一下午在九龍城沙浦道地盤從天台墮下約十層樓，其後送院不治。

en.headline: EuroCham says five-year plan gives firms clear strategic vision
en.dek: The European Chamber of Commerce in Hong Kong said the city’s first five-year plan will help foreign businesses understand long-term priorities and prepare products and solutions accordingly.

zh.headline: 歐洲商會：五年規劃助企業掌握長遠方向
zh.dek: 香港歐洲商會表示，本港首個五年規劃讓外資企業更清楚了解香港的長遠策略目標，有助提前部署產品及方案。

en.headline: Lawmakers call for tighter safety rules after triathlon drowning
en.dek: Legislators urged organisers to introduce real-time tracking and clearer weather protocols following the death of a 59-year-old competitor during the swim leg at Tai Mei Tuk on Sunday.

zh.headline: 議員促三項鐵人賽加強安全措施
zh.dek: 立法會議員就周日大美督三項鐵人賽游泳項目有選手遇溺不治，促請主辦單位引入實時追蹤及更清晰的天氣指引。

en.headline: Red flags raised at eight beaches over poor water quality forecast
en.dek: The Leisure and Cultural Services Department hoisted red flags at beaches across several districts after the Environmental Protection Department forecast very poor water quality following heavy rain.

zh.headline: 八個泳灘因水質預測非常差懸掛紅旗
zh.dek: 康文署表示，環保署泳灘水質預測指數為4，多個泳灘水質預測屬非常差，已懸掛紅旗，呼籲泳客不要下水。

en.headline: Financial Secretary hails China Government Bond Futures as key offshore RMB tool
en.dek: Paul Chan said the launch closes a critical gap in the offshore renminbi toolkit and strengthens Hong Kong’s role as a risk-management hub.

zh.headline: 財政司司長：國債期貨補上離岸人民幣工具關鍵拼圖
zh.dek: 陳茂波在港交所五年期中國國債期貨上市儀式上表示，產品為離岸人民幣工具箱補上重要一環，強化香港風險管理中心角色。

en.headline: CSRC and SFC announce new measures to deepen Hong Kong-Mainland market links
en.dek: The regulators unveiled 10 measures covering cross-boundary listings, ETFs, indices, RMB futures and professional qualifications to strengthen co-operation.

zh.headline: 中證監與證監會公布深化兩地市場合作新措施
zh.dek: 監管機構公布十項措施，涵蓋跨境上市、ETF、指數合作、人民幣期貨及專業資格等範疇，加強兩地市場聯通。

en.headline: Six injured after minibus and van collide in Kwai Chung
en.dek: A light goods vehicle and a green minibus crashed at the junction of Kwai Fuk Road and Shing Fuk Street on Sunday night; all six casualties were conscious.

zh.headline: 葵涌小巴與貨車相撞 六人受傷
zh.dek: 周日晚葵涌葵福路與盛福街交界一輛輕型貨車與綠色小巴相撞，六名傷者清醒送院。

en.headline: Drivers trapped over two hours in Cityplaza car park gridlock
en.dek: Dozens of motorists were stuck in the basement car park at the Tai Koo Shing shopping centre on Sunday night and complained of being charged for the extra time.

zh.headline: 太古城中心停車場塞車逾兩小時 司機抱怨仍要收費
zh.dek: 周日晚太古城中心地庫停車場出現嚴重擠塞，多名司機受困逾兩小時，並投訴因塞車多付的泊車費。

en.headline: July rainfall second-highest on record as hikers risk dam discharge
en.dek: Hong Kong recorded 790.3 mm of rain last month, more than double the normal total, while a video showed hikers posing near a powerful flood discharge at Ho Pui Reservoir.

zh.headline: 7月雨量創有紀錄以來第二高 有人於河背水塘泄洪口旁拍照
zh.dek: 天文台指上月錄得790.3毫米雨量，超過正常一倍，為1884年有紀錄以來第二高；網上片段顯示有人在元朗河背水塘泄洪口附近危險位置拍照。

en.headline: Ride-hailing regulatory regime takes effect with combined taxi test launch
en.dek: Most legal provisions governing ride-hailing services come into force today, while the Transport Department begins accepting applications for a new combined taxi and ride-hailing vehicle driving test.

zh.headline: 網約車規管制度今日生效 合併駕駛考試同步開放申請
zh.dek: 規管網約車服務的大部分法例條文今日起生效，運輸署同日推出的士及網約車合併駕駛考試並開始接受申請。

en.headline: Amber rainstorm and thunderstorm warnings in force this morning
en.dek: The Hong Kong Observatory issued an Amber Rainstorm Warning at 6.40am, with the Thunderstorm Warning also remaining in force under a broad trough of low pressure.

zh.headline: 黃色暴雨及雷暴警告今早生效
zh.dek: 天文台於上午6時40分發出黃色暴雨警告信號，雷暴警告亦繼續生效，受廣闊低壓槽影響本港有大雨。

en.headline: Chief Executive meets CSRC chairman on deepening market links
en.dek: John Lee hosted China Securities Regulatory Commission chairman Wu Qing at Government House on Sunday to discuss closer financial cooperation between Hong Kong and the mainland.

zh.headline: 李家超晤中證監主席吳清 商討深化兩地金融互聯互通
zh.dek: 行政長官李家超周日在禮賓府與中國證券監督管理委員會主席吳清會面，就深化香港與內地金融市場互聯互通交流意見。

en.headline: HKEX cuts minimum tick size for mid-priced stocks from today
en.dek: Phase 2 of the minimum spreads reduction takes effect, halving the tick size for equities and other securities priced between HK$0.50 and HK$10.

zh.headline: 港交所今日起下調中價股最低上落價位
zh.dek: 最低上落價位下調第二階段今日生效，介乎0.5元至10元的股票及其他適用證券最低上落價位減半至0.005元。

en.headline: HKEX launches 5-year China Government Bond Futures today
en.dek: The first offshore China Government Bond futures contract begins trading on the Hong Kong exchange, giving investors a new tool to manage interest-rate risk on mainland bonds.

zh.headline: 港交所今日推出五年期中國國債期貨
zh.dek: 香港交易所今日起買賣首隻離岸中國國債期貨合約，為投資者提供管理內地債券利率風險的新工具。

en.headline: Thunderstorm warning in force until 5am amid heavy rain risk
en.dek: The Hong Kong Observatory has the Thunderstorm Warning in effect until 5 a.m., with intense rain bands near the Pearl River Estuary and widespread heavy rain possible in the next few hours.

zh.headline: 雷暴警告生效至清晨5時 廣泛大雨風險
zh.dek: 天文台表示雷暴警告繼續生效至今日上午5時，珠江口一帶有強烈雨帶持續影響，未來數小時本港廣泛地區可能受大雨影響。

en.headline: Residents join free Sport For All Day activities across the city
en.dek: The Leisure and Cultural Services Department offered free access to facilities and programmes on Sunday under the theme Asian Games in Motion, City in Action, with Chief Executive John Lee among participants.

zh.headline: 市民踴躍參與全民運動日免費活動
zh.dek: 康文署周日以「亞運動起來 全城動起來」為主題，全港18區指定場地提供免費設施及體育活動，行政長官李家超亦有出席。

en.headline: Fresh water supply disrupted in Kwai Chung after pipe leak
en.dek: The Water Supplies Department is conducting emergency repairs on a 200mm pipe on Ta Chuen Ping Street that supplies Po Sing Centre, aiming to restore service by midnight.

zh.headline: 葵涌水管漏水 部分地區食水暫停供應
zh.dek: 水務署正緊急搶修打磚坪街一條200毫米食水喉，影響寶星中心供水，目標午夜前恢復。

en.headline: Observatory warns of widespread heavy rain in coming hours
en.dek: The Hong Kong Observatory issued a special announcement at 5.50pm saying widespread heavy rain may affect the city in a couple of hours.

zh.headline: 天文台：未來數小時香港廣泛地區可能受大雨影響
zh.dek: 天文台下午5時50分發出特別天氣提示，指未來兩三小時本港廣泛地區可能受大雨影響，呼籲市民提高警覺。

en.headline: 59-year-old man dies after rescue from Tai Mei Tuk triathlon swim
en.dek: A participant in the Hong Kong Summer Triathlon Challenge was recovered from the sea after several hours and later certified dead in hospital.

zh.headline: 大美督三項鐵人賽男子遇溺 救起後不治
zh.dek: 一名59歲男子在大埔大美督參加夏日三項鐵人挑戰賽游泳項目期間失蹤數小時，下午被救起送院後證實死亡。

en.headline: Students may speak with astronaut Lai Ka-ying from September
en.dek: The Innovation, Technology and Industry Bureau is organising a Space-Earth Dialogue that could allow primary and secondary pupils to talk directly with Hong Kong’s first astronaut.

zh.headline: 學生最早9月可與航天員黎家盈「天地對話」
zh.dek: 創新科技及工業局局長孫東表示，中小學生最早可於9月新學年開始後，透過「天地對話」直接與香港首位航天員黎家盈通話。

en.headline: Financial Secretary signals full-year GDP forecast will be raised
en.dek: Paul Chan said the economy expanded 5.1 per cent in the first half and authorities will revise the annual growth projection upward later this month.

zh.headline: 陳茂波：上半年經濟增長5.1% 稍後上調全年預測
zh.dek: 財政司司長陳茂波在網誌表示，本港上半年經濟按年增長5.1%，當局稍後本月內會上調全年本地生產總值增長預測。

en.headline: Police arrest three more men over Tsim Sha Tsui bar murder
en.dek: A 40-year-old man was arrested for murder and two others for assisting offenders in connection with the 26 July attack that left a 32-year-old man dead.

zh.headline: 尖沙咀酒吧謀殺案再拘三人 包括一名謀殺嫌疑
zh.dek: 警方就7月26日尖沙咀樓上酒吧襲擊致死案再拘捕三名本地男子，其中40歲男子涉嫌謀殺，另外兩人涉嫌協助罪犯。

en.headline: Work-week outlook: heavy showers early then turning very hot
en.dek: The Hong Kong Observatory expects occasional heavy showers and thunderstorms on Monday, with the weather becoming brighter later in the week and very hot from Friday onwards.

zh.headline: 本周天氣預報：初段有大驟雨其後轉酷熱
zh.dek: 天文台預料周一仍有大驟雨及雷暴，其後天氣逐漸轉為明亮，周五起日間酷熱。

en.headline: Red flags raised at six beaches due to big waves and inclement weather
en.dek: The Leisure and Cultural Services Department advised beachgoers not to swim at Shek O, Big Wave Bay, Pui O, Hap Mun Bay, Silverstrand and Tai Po Lung Mei beaches on Sunday.

zh.headline: 六個泳灘因大浪及惡劣天氣懸掛紅旗
zh.dek: 康樂及文化事務署周日表示，因大浪及惡劣天氣，石澳、大浪灣、貝澳、鹹田灣、銀線灣及大埔龍尾泳灘已懸掛紅旗，呼籲泳客不要下水。

en.headline: Patrolling robot damaged after falling down staircase at Hong Kong airport
en.dek: The Airport Authority said a humanoid robot tumbled down a staircase in Terminal One during a test run on Saturday, resulting in partial damage with no injuries reported.

zh.headline: 機場巡邏機械人測試期間墮梯損毀
zh.dek: 機場管理局表示，一部人形機械人周六在一號客運大樓進行測試時墮下樓梯，局部損毀，無人受傷。

en.headline: Chief Executive holds first district consultation on five-year plan in Tuen Mun
en.dek: John Lee and principal officials met more than 130 residents at South Tuen Mun Government Secondary School on Sunday to gather views on Hong Kong’s first five-year plan and the 2026 Policy Address.

zh.headline: 李家超於屯門舉行首場五年規劃及施政報告地區諮詢會
zh.dek: 行政長官李家超與主要官員周日在南屯門官立中學會見逾130名市民及地區代表，就香港首個五年規劃及2026年施政報告聽取意見。

en.headline: Inter Milan beat Manchester City on penalties at Kai Tak Stadium
en.dek: The Italian champions won 3-1 in the shootout after a 1-1 draw in the opening match of the Hong Kong Football Festival, with Divin Mubama scoring for City.

zh.headline: 國際米蘭十二碼擊敗曼城 凱旋體育場足球節揭幕戰
zh.dek: 意甲冠軍於香港足球節揭幕戰1比1賽和後，以3比1贏十二碼勝出，曼城新帥任內首球由穆巴馬打進。

en.headline: Amber rainstorm and thunderstorm warnings in force this morning
en.dek: The Hong Kong Observatory issued an Amber Rainstorm Warning at 6.10am and a Thunderstorm Warning earlier, with heavy showers and risk of flooding in low-lying areas.

zh.headline: 黃色暴雨及雷暴警告今早生效
zh.dek: 天文台於上午6時10分發出黃色暴雨警告信號，較早前已發出雷暴警告，本港有大雨及低窪地區可能水浸。

en.headline: PLA Hong Kong Garrison marks 99th anniversary of army founding with reception
en.dek: Political commissar Rear Admiral Lai Ruxin and Chief Executive John Lee spoke at the event held at Ngong Shuen Chau Barracks on Stonecutters Island.

zh.headline: 駐港部隊舉行建軍99周年招待會
zh.dek: 政治委員賴汝新少將及行政長官李家超在昂船洲軍營出席活動並致辭。

en.headline: Police arrest 57 including 14-year-old in triad debt collection crackdown
en.dek: Officers dismantled a triad-controlled syndicate that recruited youths for red-paint attacks and threats, also shutting a brothel, drug den and three illegal gambling dens.

zh.headline: 警搗破三合會放數集團拘57人 包括14歲少年
zh.dek: 警方瓦解一個三合會操控的非法追債集團，並搗破一間色情場所、一所毒窟及三個非法賭場，部分被捕者年紀僅十多歲。
